products.name: Dyna Rehaid Walking Frame (Walker) | Walker for Elders
products.description:
Foldable Mobility Walking Aid for Elderly
DYNA REHAID Walkers are designed to provide dependable support, enhanced stability, and greater confidence for individuals experiencing mobility challenges. Whether recovering from surgery, managing age-related balance issues, or undergoing rehabilitation, our walkers help users move safely while reducing the risk of falls and strain.
Engineered for strength, comfort, and ease of use, the DYNA REHAID walker range offers solutions to match varying mobility needs — from maximum stability support to smoother, more natural movement. With durable construction and user-friendly designs, DYNA REHAID walkers promote independence and support a safer return to everyday activities.

		
	

	
		
			Dyna Walking Frame — Key Features &amp; Benefits

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			Lightweight Yet Strong ConstructionThe Dyna Walking Frame is made from high‑grade aluminium, offering an ideal balance of strength and lightness. This makes it easy for users to lift, maneuverer, and transport the walker with minimal effort.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			Telescopic Height Adjustment Just with a one-touch button the height can be adjusted as per the height of the user or as per requirement. The height of the walking frame can be adjusted from 30 inches to 36 inches in 1-inch increments. Height of paediatric walkers can be adjusted from 22 inches to 26 inches in 1 inch increments.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			Ergonomic Hand GripsThe frame comes with comfortable, non‑slip hand grips that reduce fatigue and offer a secure hold, even during extended use.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			 Reliable Anti‑Slip TipsEquipped with anti‑skid rubber tips, the walker maintains a strong grip on various surfaces, improving safety on both indoor and outdoor terrain.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			Excellent Stability and Support
Wide and deep frame with sturdy construction and maximum load-bearing capacity of 100kg which properly distributes the weight and prevents fall among patients during walking and enhances overall balance.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			 Easy to use and Operate
Our walker is designed with a comfy push-button mechanism that is effortless to operate. It can be used safely with a one-touch button release and no worries of falling or loosing balance while operating the walker.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			 Foldable for Easy Storage and TransportThe Dyna Walking Frame features a foldable design, so it can be easily collapsed for storage or travel - ideal for users who need mobility at home and on the go.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			

Light Weight &amp; Rust Proof
The anodized aluminum structure ensures maximum strength and safety while remaining lightweight.



		
	

	
		
			🧭 HOW TO CHOOSE THE RIGHT WALKER

		
	

	
		
			🔹 1️⃣ Standard Walker
Best for: Maximum stability &amp; full weight support✔ No wheels for firm grip✔ Ideal for post-surgery &amp; weak balance✔ Suitable for indoor use
👉 Choose if patient needs maximum support

		
	

	
		
			🔹 2️⃣ Walker with Wheels
Best for: Easier movement with less lifting effort✔ Smooth forward movement✔ Reduces energy strain✔ Good for elderly users
👉 Choose if patient has moderate strength &amp; endurance

		
	

	
		
			🔹 3️⃣ Reciprocal Walker
Best for: Natural walking movement✔ Moves alternately with each step✔ Promotes natural gait pattern✔ Reduces joint strain
👉 Choose for gait training &amp; neurological rehab

			Walker Usage &amp; Patient Guidance

		
	

	
		
			When is a Walker Recommended?
A walker is recommended when:




Balance is compromised


Weight bearing must be reduced


Fall risk is high


Recovery requires stable support


Muscle strength is insufficient for a cane





		
	

	
		
			Who Should Use a Walker?


Elderly individuals with balance issues


Post-surgery recovery (hip, knee, spine)


Patients with arthritis or muscle weakness


Neurological conditions affecting mobility


Injury rehabilitation support



		
	

	
		
			How to Use a Walker Correctly
Adjust the height of the walker to be about waist-high. The height should be comfortable for the patient. It should allow for a slight bend of the elbow when you hold the handgrips of the walker - this is necessary to maintain blood circulation when using the walking frame. The ideal height (upto the handgrip) is the height of the patient upto the wrist when standing with arms on the side and elbows slightly bent.
Standard Walker:


Place the walker one step ahead.


Move the injured or weaker leg forward.


Shift weight onto the walker.


Bring the stronger leg forward.


Walker with Wheels:


Push the walker forward gently.


Step forward without lifting the frame.


Maintain upright posture.


Reciprocating Walker:


Move one side forward.


Step with the opposite leg.


Repeat for natural walking rhythm.



		
	

	
		
			Walker Safety Tips




Always place all four legs firmly on the ground.


Avoid leaning too far forward.


Use rubber tips in good condition.


Ensure floors are dry and obstacle-free.


Wear supportive footwear.





		
	

	
		
			Maintenance &amp; Care Tips


Clean frame regularly


Check rubber tips for wear


Ensure joints remain tight


Store in a dry place

products.name: NewMom Disposable Maternity Pad
products.description:
NEWMOM MATERNITY PAD: Extra Absorbent Maternity Pads for Postpartum Care

		
	

	
		
			NewMom Maternity Pads are longer, wider and much more absorbent than ordinary sanitary pads.
A new mother typically experiences profuse bleeding starting immediately after child birth and lasting for around 10 days. The pads will be required to change every one-two hours immediately after giving birth. This frequency will reduce to every three-four hours over the next three days. Ordinary pads will not suit the purpose as the bleeding will be extensive and there is a chance of infection. Hence it's important to buy maternity pads, rather than ordinary sanitary pads.

With the added discomfort of episiotomy or C-section stitches, any inferior quality ordinary pads will make a woman’s mind preoccupied with tension and discomfort when her mind and energy has to be given for her baby.
The constant efforts needed to change the pad frequently, cleaning of clothes caused due to rewetting are all hurdles in her way to ensuring good health and hygiene.

NEWMOM Maternity Pads are specially designed to meet the unique hygiene needs of new mothers. Whether you’re recovering from childbirth or managing urinary incontinence, our maternity pads offer superior comfort, high absorbency, and skin-friendly protection.
With two carefully developed variants – Maxi Pad and Medi Pad – NEWMOM ensures that every mother receives the right level of support during postpartum recovery and beyond.

		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
		
			
		
	

	
		
			Key Benefits
🔒   Super Absorbent Core (SAP) – Rapidly absorbs and locks fluid into a gel, offering maximum dryness even during profuse postpartum bleeding.
💧    High SAP Content – Significantly reduces rewetting and leakage, ensuring a dry and hygienic perineal area.
📏   Extra Length &amp; Width – Provides complete front-to-back and side protection, unlike ordinary pads.
🧵   Elastic Side Gatherings – Prevents side leaks and offers a body-hugging fit.
☁️   Soft &amp; Non-Irritating Material – Specially chosen fabric for sensitive postnatal skin.
🔁   Long-Lasting Absorption – Less frequent pad changes reduce disruption during recovery.
📌   Wide Adhesive Strip – Ensures the pad stays securely in place, even during movement.
🌬️   Odour Control – Lasts for long hours without developing an unpleasant smell.

&nbsp;
Clinically Backed Safety Features
🧪  Highest Absorption Capacity – 800 ml – Helps prevent perineal wetness, a key factor in avoiding infection.
🚫  Phthalate &amp; Dioxin-Free – Free from carcinogenic chemicals; safe for prolonged use.
⚖️  Maintains Optimum pH – Creates a microbe-resistant environment to prevent infection.
🌍  Biocompatible &amp; Compostable – Safe for your body and the planet.

🧬 Powered by Advanced ADL Technology for rapid fluid distribution.

&nbsp;
Why This Matters
Postpartum Lochia and persistent wetness can increase the risk of perineal and reproductive tract infections. NEWMOM Maternity Pads offer a scientifically engineered, doctor-recommended solution that protects both you and your environment.

🩸 NEWMOM MAXI PAD

Your First Line of Protection After Childbirth
NEWMOM Maxi Pad is designed to handle heavy postpartum bleeding, especially in the first few days after childbirth. The high-absorbency core and leak-proof back sheet ensure maximum security and comfort.
Key Features


High-capacity absorbent core for heavy flow


Leak-lock channels to prevent side leakage


Longer and wider back for overnight protection


Soft top layer prevents irritation to sensitive skin


Individually wrapped for hygiene and convenience


✅ Best suited for hospital stay and initial recovery days

		
	

	
		
			💧 NEWMOM MEDI PAD
Dual-Purpose Pad for Postpartum Spotting &amp; Incontinence
NEWMOM Medi Pad offers versatile protection for new mothers who experience light postpartum bleeding or urinary incontinence, a common issue after delivery. Its slim, ultra-soft design ensures all-day freshness without bulkiness.
Key Features


Lightweight and discreet for daily wear


Rapid fluid distribution layer for dryness


Odour neutralizers for confidence


Ideal for mild bladder leaks


Breathable material reduces risk of rashes


✅ Can be used well beyond the postpartum phase for women with light incontinence

		
	


	
		
			🛒 Which Pad is Right for You?


Use Maxi Pad during the first 7–10 days post-delivery when bleeding is heaviest.


Switch to Medi Pad after the initial phase or if you are dealing with urinary incontinence or mild spotting.


💡Tip: For C-section or vaginal delivery, Maxi Pad is often recommended during hospital stay and immediately after discharge. Medi Pad is a convenient transition pad for ongoing comfort.

		
	

	
		
			Recommended By Experts in Maternal Care
Backed by years of experience in women’s health and hygiene, NEWMOM Maternity Pads are trusted by gynaecologists and hospitals across India. Our pads are made to support not just healing, but also a positive, confident postpartum experience.

products.name: Dyna Hinged Knee Brace Premium | Neoprene | Joint Stability &amp; Pain Relief | Unisex
products.description:
The Dyna Hinged Knee Brace Premium is designed to provide enhanced stability and controlled movement for injured or weakened knees. Made with high-quality neoprene material, it offers excellent compression, warmth, and comfort, helping reduce pain and support faster recovery.
The brace features medial and lateral metal hinges that help prevent side-to-side knee movement, ensuring dependable support during daily activities, sports, or post-surgical rehabilitation. Its wrap-around design allows for easy application, a customized fit, and secure positioning without slipping.

		
	

	
		
			Features:

Neoprene Material

High-quality neoprene fabric ensures optimal compression to reduce swelling and inflammation.
Retains therapeutic warmth to promote blood circulation and faster healing.
Soft, durable, and skin-friendly material for all-day comfort.


Wrap-Around Design

Easy to wear and remove, making it suitable for individuals with limited mobility.
Adjustable straps allow for a snug, secure fit tailored to individual needs.


Weight-Bearing Metal Hinges

Robust metal hinges provide excellent lateral and medial support to stabilize the knee.
Facilitates controlled and safe movement during rehabilitation or daily activities.
Especially useful for ligament injuries, meniscus tears, and post-surgery care.


Open Patella Design with Patellar Buttress

Relieves pressure on the kneecap to enhance comfort and reduce pain.
The built-in patellar buttress offers targeted support, ensuring proper alignment and minimizing tracking issues.





		
	

	
		
			Application Guide
			
		
	

	
		
			Indications:

Mild to moderate medio-lateral instability of the knee
Post surgical rehabilitation
Non operative management of injured knee
Patella dislocation or subluxation


		
	

	
		
			Benefits:

Stabilizes the knee and helps prevent unwanted movement
Reduces pain and supports healing
Enhances confidence during activity
Suitable for daily use, physiotherapy, or sports recovery
